tutorials.title: Install your first Form app
tutorials.summary: Find an app, install it, open it and let it update itself.

steps.title: Open Apps
steps.body: Apps lists the whole Form family. Filter by Installed or Not installed, or search by name or by what an app replaces.

steps.title: Install an app
steps.body: Choose Install on its row. FormPortal checks the catalogue's signature and the file's SHA-256 before anything is unpacked, and installs for you only, with no administrator.

steps.title: Open it
steps.body: Choose Open on its row, or on Home under Your apps.

steps.title: Let it update itself
steps.body: In Preferences, Apps, keep automatic updates on. Updates run while FormPortal is open, and an app you have open is never replaced under you.

tutorials.title: Try a beta beside stable
tutorials.summary: Install a beta build without touching the stable one, then remove it again.

steps.title: Open Beta
steps.body: Beta lists builds still being tested. A beta installs beside the stable build and keeps its own settings.

steps.title: Install the beta
steps.body: Choose Install on its row. Your stable build stays as it is, so you can open either one.

steps.title: Remove it when you are done
steps.body: In the beta's More menu, choose Remove from this computer. The stable build is not touched.

tutorials.title: Go back a version
tutorials.summary: Undo an update that went wrong, or install any version the catalogue lists.

steps.title: Keep the version before
steps.body: In Preferences, Apps, Keep the version before, to go back to is on by default, so every update keeps the version it replaced.

steps.title: Go back
steps.body: In an app's More menu, choose Go back to the version before. Automatic updates for that app turn off so it stays where you put it.

steps.title: Any other version
steps.body: Other versions in the same menu lists every version the catalogue offers for this computer.

tutorials.title: Keep your projects on your own disk
tutorials.summary: Tell FormPortal where your projects live, open them in the right app, and go back to an earlier version.

steps.title: Choose a folder
steps.body: In Files, choose Choose a folder, or Use the suggested folder (Documents/Form). Nothing leaves your computer.

steps.title: Open a project
steps.body: Recent projects lists your Form projects, newest first. Open starts the app that makes it.

steps.title: Go back to an earlier version
steps.body: Versions shows up to 20 earlier copies FormPortal kept. Choose Go back to this on the one you want.

steps.title: See what uses your disk
steps.body: Storage shows what FormPortal and each projects folder take up.

tutorials.title: Fonts and stock with their licences
tutorials.summary: Install open fonts, add your own, and save stock or start from a template with its credit kept.

steps.title: Install a font family
steps.body: In Fonts, choose Install family. Only open licences (OFL, Apache-2.0, MIT) are offered, and the fonts are installed for you alone.

steps.title: Add your own font
steps.body: Add a font file takes a TTF or OTF once you confirm you have the right to use it on this computer.

steps.title: Save stock with its credit
steps.body: In Stock & templates, Save puts an item in your Library with its credit line beside it. CC BY items need that credit wherever you use them.

steps.title: Start from a template
steps.body: Use template copies a template into your projects folder and opens it in its app.

tutorials.title: Work with your AI agent
tutorials.summary: Connect an app to Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, and ask your agent about your apps from FormPortal.

steps.title: Connect an app
steps.body: An app that ships its own MCP server has a section on its page called Use (the app) with your AI tools. Choose Connect beside Claude Code, Codex or Cursor; it stays connected across updates.

steps.title: Ask your agent here
steps.body: Ask your agent, in the top bar, sends a question to the agent installed on this computer. It can read FormPortal (apps, installs, updates, disk use, fonts, stock, extensions, tutorials) but cannot install or remove anything from there.

steps.title: Let it do the work
steps.body: To have an agent install or update apps, add FormPortal's own server (./formportal mcp) to it; it asks you before installing, going back or removing.
